query:
INSERT INTO mail_message
                   (id, recipient_id, sender_id, sent_at, read_at, key_id, subject, body)
               SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?
               WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM mail_message WHERE recipient_id = ?) < ?
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mail_message WHERE id = ?)
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
